items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-10-14
items.q: Russ was in the Navy, Russ. Russ, Henry Russ, Said.

ctx.x: Yeah, I know, where they had the pub houses.

Yeah, but last time we left there with that big parade, he was standing on Jackson Avenue. Russ was in the Navy, Russ. Russ, Henry Russ, Said. Oh, yeah. We had a very good trombone player and music teacher from Wallace Collins and Boatron Adams.
How long were you in the Navy there, Henry?
